name: Cathedral Square
summary: In Cathedral Square, faith and civic life gather beneath the Cathedral of Light. City Hall, the orphanage, and the Argent Dawn's Stormwind headquarters are here.

sections.title: The Holy District
sections.body: Northwest of the Trade District and southeast of the Dwarven District, Cathedral Square draws the faithful from across the Kingdom of Stormwind. The Cathedral of Light rises above the square, foremost sanctuary of the Holy Light across Azeroth. Priests, paladins, and healers come to study, pray, and train. Citizens and pilgrims mingle with schoolchildren led by School Mistress Danna.

sections.title: Civic Heart and Holy Order
sections.body: Prayer shares Cathedral Square with the kingdom's work. City Hall and the Stormwind Orphanage anchor its civic life. Along the avenues, armorers and weaponsmiths serve holy crusaders, including Righteous Plates and Just Maces. The Argent Dawn keeps its Stormwind base here. Its recruiters and representatives coordinate relief and rally champions against the Scourge in the northern kingdoms.

faq.answer: Cathedral Square gathers worship and civic life around the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind City. City Hall, the local orphanage, and shops fill the district.
Priests, paladins, and healers study and train in Cathedral Square and the Cathedral of Light. Medics and caregivers study here with First Aid trainers.

faq.q: Why is the Argent Dawn located here?
faq.answer: The Argent Dawn keeps a base in Cathedral Square to recruit champions and coordinate support from Stormwind against the Scourge in the Plaguelands.
Bridges and canal paths connect Cathedral Square to the Trade District to the southeast, the Dwarven District to the northwest, and the Park to the southwest.

angles.text: As a paladin, you can find mentors, sacred vows, and armorers for holy warriors in Cathedral Square.
As a priest, you can study the Holy Light, pray, and minister to Stormwind's citizens in the square's halls and spires.
